<thought>To obtain all possible precursor sets for the given target molecule using template 29646, I will apply the template to the target SMILES via the `apply_template` tool. This will return every applicable retrosynthetic outcome, each as a list of precursor SMILES.</thought>
<action>apply_template</action>
<action_input>{"molecule_smiles": "O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O", "template_id": "29646"}</action_input>
